sections.title: The letter zeta
paragraphs: The letter is named (zeta) /ˈdzɛta/. Its main sound is heard in (zaino) /ˈdzai̯.no/, which means backpack. This letter can make two different sounds in Italian.

sections.title: Saying the sounds
paragraphs: For the first sound, place your tongue on the ridge behind your upper teeth. Stop the air, then release it through a narrow gap with no voice. For the second sound, make that exact same movement while your vocal cords vibrate. Place your hand on your throat to feel the shaking.

sections.title: When each sound occurs
paragraphs: This letter is voiceless before certain endings, as in (stazione) /statˈtsjoːne/. It is also voiceless after some consonants, as in (marzo) /ˈmartso/. The letter is voiced at the start of many words, like (zero) /ˈdzɛːro/.

sections.title: Common English mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pronounce this letter like the soft hiss in the English word zoo. Start every sound with a firm stop, like the letters ts in cats or ds in beds.
